ORDER BY l.CREATED_AT DESC, l.CODE DESC LIMIT #{perPage} OFFSET #{offset}

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ADMIN_ACTIVITY_LOG ( ADM_CODE, TARGET_TYPE, TARGET_CODE, PROCESS_TYPE, MEMO, CREATED_AT, REPORT_CODE ) VALUES ( #{adminCode}, #{targetType}, #{targetCode}, #{processType}, #{memo}, #{createdAt}, #{reportCode, jdbcType=INTEGER} )
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT l.CODE, l.TARGET_TYPE, l.TARGET_CODE, l.PROCESS_TYPE, l.MEMO, l.CREATED_AT FROM ADMIN_ACTIVITY_LOG l WHERE l.ADM_CODE = #{targetCode} ORDER BY l.CREATED_AT DESC, l.CODE DESC LIMIT #{perPage} OFFSET #{offset} ) AS l ORDER BY l.CREATED_AT DESC, l.CODE DESC
